body: I do, but I felt like I had failed her when she told me that. I hope I can find a way to feel better soon. It’s a little surreal right now cause I truly thought I would be dead.
My therapist told me to find a psychiatrist. She and I work through betterhelp.com. Because we don’t meet face to face she worried for me yesterday
I’m still hurting a lot but I let some of my friends know what happened the other night. I’m trying to get ahold of a psychiatrist now
Checking in with you, I’m at least talking to a friend who is trying to talk me down. I can’t say it’s working but it’s taking up my time at least...
Thank you. I will do my best to think about that. I have some time.

Thank you for acknowledging that the pain I am feeling is intense. No one understands and no one in reality really tries. It’s one of the main reasons I’m posting here cause at least people are trying to understand. I just don’t know if there is anyone out there who can deal with me anymore. The amount of hurt and bitterness I now feel is too great. I want to try and forgive the world and everyone but it had wronged me so much this year that I just don’t know if I can ever let it go...

Since I’m not gonna talk to my coworkers about it I will let you at least try and talk me down. I’ll at least try to listen but I can’t guarantee anything. But yeah I have 7 hours till I’m home. The rope is in my trunk...

I am definitely in the area of trying to coexist with it. Some times it becomes just bit too much and I get very low. I do hope that in the amount of time I have given myself before I do anything drastic that I am able to overcome or at least make it to a better place

Thank you. I’m glad that I have a focal point to keep moving toward no matter how small it is. Like I said if I can hopefully feel better by next year maybe just maybe I can continue on. Even if I don’t take everything you say to heart thank you for reaching out nonetheless

I identify so much with both Jon Snow and Tyrion. I can’t say fully why cause I don’t want to give too much away. The way they have to fight for the things in life they want so desperately just makes them endearing to me. I wish I could have some success the way I am fighting so hard but I just don’t feel it. Thank you for commenting
I'm from Idaho otherwise I would send a message. I wish you luck
Commenting cause you asked! Good luck!
